en: "...Useless."{w}
note: Narv speaks in stilted katakana in the source; rendered terse and formal throughout, no contractions.

en:
"Ngh..."{w}{p}"Wait.
Not yet... I...!"{w}
note: Shaharon pleading as Narv turns on it; "mada... watashi wa..." trails off.

en: "Receive judgment."{w}

"Ugoooh!!
...Gwaaargh...!"{w}
Shaharon was struck by a fierce bolt of lightning.{w}{p}Dark smoke rose from Shaharon's body in countless trails, and those two long arms crumpled to the floor, robes and all.{w}
note: No pronoun for Shaharon (gender unknown): "its two long arms" -> "those two long arms".

en:
"Let us go and dispose
of the useless one."{w}
note: sutete yuku ka: Narv deciding to dump Shaharon (cf. chap 1376, same verb for Necrophilis).

en: A dark abyss welled up around Narv and the others.{w}The spirit who had drowned in the power of darkness was swallowed into the bottomless abyss along with Narv, leaving no trace...{w}
note: Parallel to chap 1378/1392. "The spirit" = Shaharon (row 1417: Shaharon was once a spirit like Yorfa).

en:
"Defy us, and you will suffer the same.
Take that to heart."{w}

Leaving those ominous words behind,
Narv departed.{w}
note: Source has no final period; added one, as in normal narration.

en: At the back of the room were Dark Mayer and a spirit who appeared to be the Moonlight Spirit.{w}

"I won't let you get in my way either.
I will save Rafa, no matter what!"{w}
note: Yorfa to the party ("anata-tachi ni mo").
Dark Mayer to Yorfa (omae). Phrased to avoid a pronoun for Rafa / the Sun Spirit.

en:
"......Hold on.
Very soon, I'll have you..."{w}
note: Yorfa addressing Rafa (anata o), trailing off; kept unfinished.

en: "N-no..."{w}{p}"Rafa... to get you out,{w}I'd have to..."{w}
note: sonna... = dismay at what the rescue requires (Dark Mayer's hint in 1436). Sentence cut at the {w} as in the source.
Dark Mayer turning on Yorfa. "kataku-na ni buji o shinjiru" rendered without a pronoun for the Sun Spirit.

en:
"I must hand it to you lot.{w}But this Palace of the Sun is already
being joined to the Dark Realm."{w}
note: Dark Mayer to the party (omae-tachi), apparently after the fight. anniki = "the Dark Realm" (wmap slice_20 row 1526).

en: Welsconi
note: New name: weru-suko-o-ni. Appears in the same scene slot as Dark Fuhrer (1443/1445, 1446/1451 are parallel lines), so probably alternative bosses of one encounter.

en: "So this is the true power of the Kin of Darkness..."{w}{p}"Our great king...{w}Behold the power of Numbra Malem!"{w}
note: kin of darkness: lowercase as in chap slice_008 / wmap slice_20. Numbra Malem: new name (nunbura mare-mu); "Numbra" matches "Numbra Narv" in chap 1360.

en: Dark Fuhrer
note: New name: da-ku fyu-ra- (German Fuehrer, "leader"); umlaut dropped for ASCII.

en:
"With Narv as the conduit, power is
flowing in from the Void Axis."{w}{p}"The power of our great king,
Numbra Malem, is growing
ever stronger..."{w}{p}"Fwahahaha...{w}Nothing is left for you now
but despair!!"{w}
note: kyosuuki = "Void Axis" (new term). Its counterpart jissuuki (chap 1360, slice_017, Narv's true home) would be "True Axis". The pair is literally real/imaginary (as in jitsujiku/kyojiku, real/imaginary axis).

en:
"......
O king of our Dark Realm..."{w}{p}"I could not live up to your expectations...
Forgive... me..."{w}{p}"Numbra Male...m...
may this world... be... yours...{w}Uuugh... Gwaaah...!!"{w}
note: Same wording as 1451 (Dark Fuhrer variant). The name is broken mid-word in the source; kept.

en: Dark light burst outward from Welsconi's body, and the body faded away as if evaporating, starting from the arms stretched toward the heavens.{w}
note: Same wording as 1452.
Same as 1453. Nertowa from wmap slice_02 row 152. watashi mo... = Yorfa echoing Rafa's wish to return to the old days; trails off.

en: Yorfa, the Moonlight Spirit, faded from the spot, utterly dejected...{w}

The presence of darkness faded from the Palace of the Sun, which had been shrouded in the dark, dense presence of the Dark Realm...{w}{p}Strong yet gentle sunlight poured down from the sky, from the Palace of the Sun onto the land.{w}

note: Same wording as 1446; here the source has {w} after the ellipsis instead of a line break.

en: Dark light burst outward from the Dark Fuhrer's body, and the body faded away as if evaporating, starting from the arms stretched toward the heavens.{w}
note: Same as 1447. "the Dark Fuhrer" with article in narration, like "the Floor Master".

en:
"Ah, Rafa..."{w}{p}"You're suffering, and I can't save you..."{w}{p}"I want to be with you like before, too...{w}The two of us, like back when we
watched over the land in Nertowa..."{w}
note: Same as 1448 (the source differs only by one line break).

en: *            Light enveloped you           *{0F}{w}
note: Caption box; source width 22 full-width cells = 44 ASCII cells, text centred with spaces. No period, like the source and the parallel "wind" caption (chap 1514). The opening {0E} is not in this string (as in the source).

Three-line highlighted banner (area title). Each full-width space -> 2 ASCII spaces (23 cells -> 46), title centred. Check the rendered width: if 46 spaces overflow the 376 px line, shorten all three lines equally.

en:
You found Narv.
A deep presence of darkness clung to Narv.{w}

"Here, we shall become the gate
that summons the power of the Void Axis."{w}
note: Narv uses the plural "warera" throughout.

en:
"Curse you...
Do not interfere with us..."{w}
"You... are an eyesore..."{w}
"Such futile struggling..."{w}
The presence of darkness grew thicker.{w}

{0E}The presence of darkness grew thicker.{0F}
If you leave it be, the terror of death will descend upon you.{w}
note: {0E}..{0F} re-shows row 1461; English matches it exactly. Source trailing space before {w} dropped.

en: Meem
note: New name: mi-i-mu, the Fairy King (yousei-ou). "Meem" chosen over "Mime" to avoid the English word. No pronouns used.
daichi no tami = "people of the land" (the land = daichi, as in "watched over the land"). Meem's register: regal, measured.
"their devotion" = the brethren who maintain the land (1465). The sentence is cut at the first {w} as in the source.

en:
"You there. If you are indeed people of the land,
might I ask you to be of some service?"{w}
"Some insolent rabble has strayed into this fairy village.{w}They seem to be people of the land, but unlike you, they do not know how to conduct themselves."{w}{p}"Will you take this on for me?"{w}
note: tanomarete kure: Meem asking the party.

en: "I leave it in your hands."{w}
note: yoshina ni na (after the party accepts).

en:
"I see. So they were the ghosts of people of the land.
But this is the haven of the fairies.{w}We cannot take them in."{w}
note: rei = "ghost" (seirei is already "spirit").

en: "I, Meem, the Fairy King...{w}On behalf of my brethren, I shall pray that they rest in peace."{w}

"You must not make that same mistake.{w}This is the fairy village. It is not
where the people of the land go when they die."{w}
note: yuku (to pass away): where their dead belong.

en: A wandering ghost is here.{w}
Wandering Ghost
note: 15 characters.

en: "This place... how soothing it is..."{w}

"This place... how soothing it is..."{w}{p}"...We escaped from the gate...
and at long last made our way here...{w}And yet you would turn us away...!!"{w}{p}"...Unforgivable!!"{w}
note: Source lacks the closing quote of the first sentence; added it so the quotes balance. "the gate": cf. Narv as "the gate" (1457) -- lowercase, referent unclear.

en: When you peered into the spring, the faces of the people you had met so far strangely came to mind.{w}
Who will you picture?
note: Menu prompt.
Runtime insert, kept verbatim.
Runtime insert, kept verbatim.
Runtime insert, kept verbatim.
Runtime insert, kept verbatim.

en: The people you pictured appeared before you!{w}
The people from your memories vanished into the spring.{w}
People of Algrantz
People of Roscadil
People of Lumisthenes
People of Teridon
People met on your travels
note: 26 characters.

en: Electra's party
The Sun Spirit
Castle of the Wind's Master
note: 27 characters; "Castle of the Wind" from wmap slice_14. Probably Agintaitus; no gender implied by kept "Master".

en: Soul Therapist
note: Emera (chap slice_008).

en: Woman in crimson & servant
note: 26 characters. makka na koromo no josei to juusha; identity not settled by this slice.

en: Mysterious man
Next
Stop peering in
Fairy

"Take a look in there.
That spring shows all sorts of things."{w}{p}"It's just like...{w}being inside a dream."{w}
note: yume no naka is in hiragana (soft, dreamy); cut at the {w} as in the source.

en: Hotheaded Fairy
note: kishou no arai yousei; 15 characters.

en: "This is the fairy village.{w}Ye lot, mind how you carry yourselves."{w}{p}"Fail to, and I'll snatch you up and eat you."{w}
note: unura (archaic, rough "you lot") -> "Ye lot".

en: "Kyaaaah!?{w}Stop, stop, stooop!?"{w}
note: Speaker ??? = the headless girl (Dullahan, slice_019 row 1507).

en: No sooner had you heard a horse whinny than a girl appeared, riding something you weren't sure you could even call a horse.{w}{p}What's more, the girl's head was separated from her body, and the head sat in a basket hanging from her hand.{w}
note: "her" = the girl (shoujo).

en: "Calm down, calm down, I said!{w}Jeez, come on!!"{w}
note: mo-u-u!! (exasperated).
